test_title: PYST 68: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements about public sector industries is correct?

options.text: They are owned by private individuals.
​They are owned and operated by government agencies.
​They are only run in rural areas.

solution:
The correct answer is __**They are owned and operated by government agencies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Public sector industries** are owned, operated, and managed by the government or its agencies to serve the public interest.
 
• These industries are established to ensure equitable distribution of resources, promote socio-economic development, and generate employment opportunities.
 
• Examples of public sector industries include **Indian Railways, Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC), and National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC)**.
 
• They are major contributors to infrastructure development and public welfare initiatives in India.
 
• Public sector industries function under the direct supervision of the government, ensuring accountability and regulation to avoid exploitation and monopolistic practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: They are owned by private individuals**

 
 
• This statement refers to **private sector industries**, which are owned and operated by private individuals or groups for profit.
 
• Their primary goal is profit maximization, and they are not directly controlled by the government.
 
• Examples include Tata Group, Reliance Industries, and Infosys.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: They operate without government regulation**
 
 
• This is incorrect as public sector industries are closely regulated by the government to ensure compliance with laws, policies, and ethical standards.
 
• Government regulation ensures these industries align with national priorities and public welfare.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: They are only run in rural areas**
 
 
• This is a misconception as public sector industries operate across both urban and rural areas depending on their objectives and requirements.
 
• For example, industries like power generation (NTPC) and railways operate nationwide, while certain initiatives like rural electrification may focus on rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) Overview**
 
 
• PSUs are classified into three categories: **Maharatna, Navratna, and Miniratna**, based on their financial performance and operational autonomy.
 
• They play a vital role in nation-building by supporting critical sectors like defense, infrastructure, and energy.
